name: Otoscope
instruction: Let's create an otoscope. The device should have a cylindrical handle and a conical head. The head should have a small, circular lens for viewing. Add a light source at the tip of the head. Include a button on the handle to control the light.

Shape accuracy: The head of the otoscope is conical.
The lens is circular and located on the head.
The light source is positioned at the tip of the head.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The head appears proportionate to the handle.
The lens size is appropriate for the head.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The handle is positioned correctly to support the head.
The head is properly aligned with the handle.
The lens is centered on the head.
The light source is correctly placed at the tip of the head.
Object distance and contact: There is no gap between the handle and the head.
The lens is flush with the head.
The light source is integrated into the head without any gaps.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The button on the handle is included for controlling the light.
There are no deviations from the instructions.
